statements.status_notes: Spring MVC and WebFlux applications are vulnerable to Denial of Service (DoS) attacks when resolving static resources.
statements.impact_statement: Spring Framework 7.0.8 is newer than the affected 7.0.0 through 7.0.7.1 line for static resource resolution. Liquibase Secure's reactor pins <spring.version>7.0.8</spring.version> in core/pom.xml:79, and the web-facing module declares spring-boot-starter-web in tools/liquibase-license-utility/pom.xml:59.

statements.status_notes: Due to incorrect escaping, the use of JavaScriptUtils.javaScriptEscape() may lead to JavaScript code injection in the browser, potentially resulting in a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.
statements.impact_statement: Spring Web MVC is pulled in through spring-boot-starter-web in tools/liquibase-license-utility/pom.xml:59. Repo search found no JavaScriptUtils or javaScriptEscape() usage in any Java source, so the vulnerable escaping API is never called. The reactor also pins <spring.version>7.0.8</spring.version> in core/pom.xml:79, which is past the affected release line.
